title: Replace a production preview hostname on its existing Route
description:
An agent explicitly replaces a production preview hostname with the intended private hostname while retaining the AppInstance’s sole Route and synchronizing its stored environment values.

## Scope

* In: active single-target private production Route hostname changes, stored environment synchronization, workload and Router reprojection, and bounded recovery.
* Out: application cache commands, deployment, public exposure changes, additional aliases, target changes, and automatic hostname changes from Node TLD edits.

## Acceptance

- [ ] The existing `PATCH /routes/{route}` hostname operation replaces an explicit preview or another explicit private production hostname on the same Route record; at every completed boundary the AppInstance retains exactly one Route, and invalid or occupied hostnames refuse before mutation. Proof: `apps/gateway/tests/Feature/Api/RoutesTest.php` and Incus action `production-preview-hostname`.
- [ ] The change preflights and prepares private projections, synchronizes stored environment values against the candidate hostname, and publishes and commits the new Route intent before cleaning old projections; placeholder-based APP_URL changes while unrelated stored values and literal APP_KEY remain intact. Proof: Incus action `production-preview-env-sync`.
- [ ] No Composer, Artisan, framework bootstrap, config-cache edit, worker restart, or deploy runs as part of hostname change; a cached application URL or HTTP 500 does not prevent an infrastructure-valid transition. Proof: `apps/gateway/tests/Feature/Domain/ConvergeRouteActionTest.php` and Incus action `production-preview-cached-config`.
- [ ] A failure before publication restores old Route intent, environment-file projection, and owned infrastructure; failure or interruption during commit, cleanup, or restoration remains bounded and resumable without claiming completion, and retry revalidates recorded progress. Proof: Incus action `production-preview-retry`.
- [ ] A conflicting deployment, clone finalization, removal, or environment write cannot run through the hostname transition; source code, current release, SQLite data, and local PHP tuning remain untouched, and existing development hostname changes still pass. Proof: `apps/gateway/tests/Feature/Domain/RouteMutationReconciliationTest.php`.
- [ ] Maintained documentation describes explicit preview replacement, environment synchronization, recovery, and separate agent-configured cache commands, and generated context is current. Proof: `composer docs-lint`.
- [ ] Changed project checks and repository suites pass. Proof: `cd apps/gateway && composer check`, and all five full no-TIA CI suites on the submitted candidate, plus focused affected Pest tests locally.
